params.body:
Intelligence now opens the Observatory to read: a client on the top plan sees, as a guest, the record its posts and reports come from (no Ask, nothing that writes).

- `INTELLIGENCE_ABILITIES` gets `observatory`. The unlisted Observatory plan opens the same doors and stays for people the team gives access without Intelligence.
- These are the defaults. The offer an admin saved on Settings, Plans wins plan by plan, so the live offer changes when the Observatory box is ticked for Intelligence there.

Tests: `test/plans-setting.test.mjs`, `test/guest-role.test.mjs` (26 pass).
params.title: Intelligence opens the Observatory to read
